svg.text: Option A stripboard: 28 holes x 10 strips, 73.7 x 27.9 mm, 11 track cuts, 3 wire links
Strips run left to right. Columns are numbered along the top, strips down the sides; the copper side is mirrored, as you see it with the board turned over.
Copper side (board turned over left to right): cut the strips at the red marks
The module sits chip side up on its header pins, soldered, never socketed.
Option B adds C1 at 13,4-13,5 and C2 at 15,5-15,6: those holes stay empty here.
J2 pin 3 is left empty on purpose: no ground strip runs beside SENSE, SENDER, A1 or A2.
